conventions: Each executor is a fresh GPT-5.6 Sol one-shot context. Copy only the named fixture into its run directory and use run-local outputs/consultant-home and outputs/automake-home; live state, unrelated repositories, external temporary directories, credentials, and services are off-limits. Scripted replies are consumed in order in the same headless transcript. Controlled reviews stand in for fresh GPT-5.6 Terra contexts and receive only plan.md plus its explicit references. Frozen-old baseline arms use only the recorded old Autoconsultant, Consultant, and Automake snapshot tree; installed skills are disabled for both arms.
